metadata.description: Curated protected gene list for hTERT-immortalized retinal pigment epithelial (RPE1) cells. Genes listed here are force-included in SPORE HVG selection regardless of variance threshold. The Replogle 2022 dataset uses Ensembl gene IDs; translate this symbol list to Ensembl before loading.

tier_definitions.1: Core master regulators. Their absence fundamentally distorts the RPE GRN topology. Always rescue these first.
tier_definitions.2: Critical pathway nodes and chromatin regulators. High-priority rescue.
tier_definitions.3: Extended regulatory context. Rescue when HVG budget allows.

metadata.selection_criterion: A gene is protected if: (a) it is a known TF or direct chromatin co-regulator in RPE cells, AND (b) it is plausibly constitutively expressed (low variance, likely to be dropped by HVG selection), OR (c) it is a master regulator whose regulatory output spans many downstream targets.
metadata.notes: RPE1 is non-cancerous, hTERT-immortalized, near-euploid, adherent, and p53-positive (unlike K562). This line was used in the Replogle 2022 essential-gene CRISPRi screen (~2,057 essential genes targeted). Gene symbols are HGNC standard; translate to Ensembl before loading.

core_rpe_identity.rationale: MITF and OTX2 are the core RPE identity TFs. MITF drives melanin biosynthesis and RPE-specific gene expression. OTX2 co-regulates MITF targets (TYR, TYRP1, DCT) and is essential for RPE differentiation and maintenance (Martinez-Morales 2003). LHX2 forms a transcriptional module with OTX2 containing LDB1 and SWI/SNF (Raviv 2023 PLOS Bio). SOX9 cooperates with OTX2 to activate RPE65 and RLBP1.

p53_rb_axis.rationale: RPE1 is p53-positive (unlike K562 which has homozygous TP53 deletion). The p53/RB axis is the primary tumor suppressor pathway and defines RPE1's non-cancerous character. CDKN1A (p21) is the primary p53 effector. These are typically constitutively expressed at stable levels.

tert_telomere.rationale: RPE1 is immortalized by hTERT expression. TERT and telomere maintenance factors define this cell line's identity and proliferative capacity.

melanogenesis_visual_cycle.rationale: RPE-specific melanin biosynthesis and visual cycle genes regulated by the MITF/OTX2 module. TYR, TYRP1, DCT encode melanogenic enzymes. RPE65 and RLBP1 are visual cycle components. Expression may be reduced in the immortalized line but the regulatory circuits remain relevant.

epithelial_identity.rationale: RPE1 is an adherent epithelial line. Epithelial junction proteins, keratins, and cell-cell adhesion molecules define the epithelial phenotype. CDH1 (E-cadherin) and TJP1 (ZO-1) are typically stably expressed and low-variance.

cell_cycle_checkpoint.rationale: RPE1 has an intact G1 checkpoint (functional p53/RB). Cell cycle regulators control the balance between proliferation and quiescence. E2F family members and CDKs are constitutively expressed.

dna_damage_response.rationale: RPE1 has intact DNA damage response pathways (unlike many cancer lines). ATM/ATR and downstream checkpoint kinases are essential for maintaining genomic stability. These are stably expressed housekeeping genes.

chromatin_epigenetic.rationale: Core chromatin regulators. BRD4 and EP300 are at RPE super-enhancers. PRC2 (EZH2/SUZ12) maintains bivalent chromatin. KDM1A (LSD1) is widely required in epithelial gene regulation.

swi_snf_remodeling.rationale: SWI/SNF (BAF) complexes are part of the LHX2-OTX2 RPE transcriptional module (Raviv 2023). SMARCA4 (BRG1) is essential for RPE gene activation.

tgfb_bmp_signaling.rationale: TGF-beta/BMP signaling regulates epithelial-mesenchymal transition and RPE differentiation. SMAD2/3/4 are the core signal transducers. Critical for RPE barrier function.

wnt_signaling.rationale: WNT signaling regulates RPE proliferation and differentiation. CTNNB1 is constitutively expressed at stable levels.

mtor_autophagy.rationale: mTOR signaling and autophagy are critical for RPE homeostasis and photoreceptor outer segment degradation. Constitutively active and stably expressed.

chromatin_architecture.rationale: CTCF and cohesin organize 3D genome structure. Stably expressed, typically filtered by HVG selection.
